basic.timestamps: GPU pass begin/end, nanoseconds; no browser precision flags; raw stamps retained
basic.total: preprocess begin to render end (point cloud: render only); excludes initial counter clears and final readback
basic.readbacks: one query resolve and map per batch, outside measured pass interval; no counter polling
basic.target: offscreen GPU texture, identical format/size/pipelines to viewer; no requestAnimationFrame or vsync
basic.order: seeded permutation, rotate by 5 positions each round; every configuration once per round
basic.wallTime: batch encoding + submit + query readback wait, not interactive application FPS

precision.timestamps: GPU pass begin/end, nanoseconds; no browser precision flags; raw stamps retained
precision.total: preprocess begin to render end (point cloud: render only); excludes initial counter clears and final readback
precision.readbacks: one query resolve and map per batch, outside measured pass interval; no counter polling
precision.target: offscreen GPU texture, identical format/size/pipelines to viewer; no requestAnimationFrame or vsync
precision.order: paired scenes, seeded scene permutation; alternate FP32/FP16 order each round
precision.wallTime: batch encoding + submit + query readback wait, not interactive application FPS
